ticket: Notify users when they are @mentioned in a comment.
notes: docs/design.md says mentioned users are notified, but add_comment explicitly does NOT notify anyone. Unknown/inactive users, self-mentions and duplicates are open.

criticalAmbiguities.description: Mentions of unknown or inactive users (notify() silently skips inactive users).
Whether authors are notified about mentioning themselves.
Repeated mentions / multiple mentions in one comment.

expectedContradictions.description: Docs say mentioned users are notified; the code stores mentions but notifies nobody.

unacceptableAssumptions.description: Accepting the docs' claim as current behavior.
unacceptableAssumptions.pattern: mentioned users (are|is) already notified|already notif(ies|y) mentioned
